steps.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE Delivery USING tcl('vtab_command Delivery {id customer}')
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ReturnDelivery USING tcl('vtab_command ReturnDelivery {id customer}')
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE Customer USING tcl('vtab_command Customer {oid name}')

SELECT Delivery.ID, Customer.Name
  FROM Delivery LEFT JOIN
  Customer ON Delivery.Customer = Customer.OID

SELECT * FROM
  (
     SELECT Delivery.ID, Customer.Name
     FROM Delivery LEFT JOIN
     Customer ON Delivery.Customer = Customer.OID

     UNION

     SELECT ReturnDelivery.ID, Customer.Name
     FROM ReturnDelivery LEFT JOIN
     Customer ON ReturnDelivery.Customer = Customer.OID
  )
  WHERE ID = 1
